question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**struggling**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is a story of **a lion.**
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**struggling**'.
 
• The verb 'struggling' should fit the blank as the **past continuous tense form** is appropriate in this context.
 
• Putting the **V1** form of verb after 'was' is grammatically incorrect. Hence, 'struggles' and 'struggle' are the incorrect options. Also, 'struggled' is also wrong as it is grammatically incorrect to put the 'ed' form of verb after 'was'.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *One day, a few hunters came into the forest and took the lion with them. They tied him up against a tree. The lion was **struggling** to get away and started to whimper. (3) ______, a mouse walked past and noticed the lion in trouble. He quickly ran and (4) ______ on the ropes to set the lion free. Both of them then (5) ______ into the jungle.*
